user.title: Connect to smart1 EMS
user.description: Enter your personal API key from the smart1 portal. Home Assistant stores it in the config entry and uses it only for read access.

data_description.api_key: The API key is hidden while you type.

plant.title: Select installation
plant.description: Select the smart1 installation to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect smart1 EMS
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid API key that still has access to this smart1 installation.

data_description.api_key: The API key is hidden while you type.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to smart1 EMS. Check the API key and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by the smart1 portal.
error.no_plants: No smart1 installations were found for this API key.
error.wrong_account: This API key does not provide access to the existing smart1 installation.

abort.already_configured: This smart1 installation is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this smart1 installation is already in progress.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key was updated successfully.
abort.wrong_account: This API key does not belong to the existing smart1 installation.

init.title: Configure derived energy
init.description: Select one power point for each energy role you want to enable. The suggested points match the detected installation. Leave a role set to — to disable it. Energy is derived from five-minute power data and imported as external statistics.

error.duplicate_energy_point: Each measurement point can be assigned to only one energy role.

abort.not_loaded: The smart1 EMS entry is not loaded. Enable it or resolve its setup error before changing these options.
